slots.name: IDENTITY
slots.doc: a sum or set identity that can fail

when.instructions: Must results from many branches or items be combined into one total or report with checkable identities?
What must the combined result satisfy?

criteria.sum-identity: totals equal the sum of parts

checklist.text: A conservation identity in minor units (W-bed R3: sum adjusted = ledger difference).
Behaviour on a failed branch is a quorum, not a silent skip.
The reduce is code; a model-written summary of totals is refused.

slots.AGG: (ps) => ({ entities: ps.length, totalMinor: ps.reduce((n, p) => n + p.totalMinor, 0) })
slots.IDENTITY: (ps, report) => Object.values(report).reduce((n, g) => n + g.totalMinor, 0) === ps.reduce((n, p) => n + p.totalMinor, 0) && Object.values(report).reduce((n, g) => n + g.entities, 0) === ps.length
